title: Gaussian quadrant probability
statement: For a correlation parameter $\rho\in(-1,1)$ and a level $\beta\in(0,1)$, the Gaussian quadrant probability is the probability, under the centered bivariate standard Gaussian distribution with correlation $\rho$, that both coordinates exceed the standard Gaussian upper quantile at level $\beta$.
